reviews.title: I like this microphone.
reviews.comment: I needed a new microphone when my Blue Yeti died.  I am very glad I purchased the Rode PodMic as the replacement.  It picks up my voice very well and the foam cover eliminates the "pops."  I like the fact that I can connect the mic to my computer via USB, or to my soundboard via XLR cable.
reviews.author: technut

reviews.title: The sound quality is amazing
reviews.comment: This is a great product. I use it for recording my podcast the sound quality is beautiful if you’re thinking about getting it I wouldn’t wait another second
